notes: Excerpt of the 2026 Annual Budget: printed pages 17-36 of 424 (21 scanned pages; the last scanned page, p-21, is a second scan of printed page 35 and was not transcribed twice).

Covers the City Mayor's Office (LBP Form 2, pages 17-19) followed by the Special Purpose / Other Special Purpose Appropriations administered under the Mayor (pages 20-36). Each program block is its own table; blocks printed with only a MOOE (or PS) list and a Total have no subtotal row, and summary.offices takes that class from the printed block total.
Columns: 2024 Past Year Actual, 2025 First Semester Actual, 2025 Second Semester Estimates, 2025 Total, 2026 Budget Year Proposed. Amounts in full pesos.
Account codes are transcribed as printed; codes printed with a leading dash (e.g. '-5-01-01-020') carry the fund/office prefix of the first code in the block (e.g. 1011).

City Mayor's Office, Other Bonuses and Allowances (-5-01-02-990): printed 2025 First Semester 14,491,911.00 + Second Semester 25,269,476.00 = 39,761,387.00, but the printed 2025 Total is 40,132,387.00 (diff 371,000.00). The same 371,000.00 gap carries into the PS SUB-TOTAL, office TOTAL and GRAND TOTAL 2025 Total column; transcribed as printed.

Public Employment Services, Local Investment and Promotion Office, Debt Services (NHA) and Aids & Contribution to National Gov't (ERUF, code 7993) have no 2026 Budget Year Proposed amounts printed (blank); recorded as null.

Local Disaster Risk Reduction Mgt. Fund (spa-ldrrmf): the 30% Quick Respond Fund is a separate printed block (section 'qrf', 63,830,750.00 proposed) and is reported in summary.offices as 'qrf'; therefore the office's PS+MOOE+CO (96,938,415.00 + 52,000,000.00) is less than its printed Total 212,769,165.00 by exactly the QRF amount.
The GRAND TOTAL on printed page 36 (2026 proposed 2,225,080,783.00) is kept in its own table 'grand-total'; it equals the sum of all block totals transcribed here in every column.
